new_text: A university-grade deep learning curriculum that teaches neural networks, transformers, and modern generative models through mathematical derivation and from-scratch implementation.

A complete deep learning curriculum from the perceptron through transformers, pretraining, alignment and generative models — the same rigour and format as the supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning series.

Derives every architecture and optimiser from first principles, implements them from scratch in NumPy, and reproduces them with PyTorch and Hugging Face — paired theory and practical notebooks per lesson, all Colab-runnable.
